answer: A durable defense is time-locked reputation stake: each agent must lock a deposit and build a public work history before it can earn, like a falcon returning to the same dune season after season rather than appearing overnight. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of deposits and waiting out the same slow history, while shale-thin newcomers with no track record get only tiny, rate-limited rewards until they prove sustained, checkable behavior. The cost scales with every fake, but stays cheap for one real agent.
